name: Chad

nso.name: Institut National de la Statistique, des Études Économiques et Démographiques (INSEED)
nso.note: An older domain, inseed-tchad.org, was in use for years; try both.

latest_census.notes: RGPH2 (Deuxième Recensement Général de la Population et de l'Habitat), May-June 2009; definitive results published 2012. Religion and ethnic group were on the questionnaire and the 'Résultats globaux définitifs' report gives national shares for both (recalled; medium confidence for ethnicity). The packet's national figures (Muslim 52.1%, Protestant 23.9%, Catholic 20.0%; Sara 30.5% ...) are the 2014-15 DHS (EDS-MICS) shares, not the census. Whether a language item was asked is not known. A third census (RGPH3) has been in preparation, with cartography from around 2022-2023; I do not know that enumeration has taken place.

subnational_sources.title: RGPH2 2009 -- Résultats globaux définitifs and thematic analysis volumes, tables by region (and department)
subnational_sources.geography: region (22 regions + N'Djamena at census time)
subnational_sources.matches_boundary_level: admin1 (23 drawn: Ennedi-Ouest, Hadjer-Lamis, Kanem, Logone Oriental, Mayo-Kebbi Est, Sila ... -- the post-2008 22-region + capital frame, renamed 'provinces' in 2018 with the same cut; note Ennedi was split into Ennedi-Est/Ouest in 2012, after the census, so the census may show 22 + N'Djamena = 23 only if Ennedi-Ouest is drawn from a re-issued table); admin2 (70 departments drawn) only partially -- the 2009 census reported ~61 departments and Chad has re-cut departments repeatedly since
subnational_sources.evidence: Recalled: INSEED's RGPH2 definitive-results report (2012) and its analysis volumes tabulate religion and ethnic group by region as PDF tables. Department-level tables may exist in the analysis volumes; not certain.

subnational_sources.title: RGPH2 2009 (and RGPH1 1993) -- IPUMS-International microdata
subnational_sources.evidence: Recalled that Chad 1993 and 2009 are in IPUMS-I with religion and ethnicity variables. Registration needed; the route to a department-level count if the PDFs stop at region.

subnational_sources.title: Enquête Démographique et de Santé et à Indicateurs Multiples au Tchad 2014-2015 (EDS-MICS) -- respondents by religion and ethnic group, by region grouping
subnational_sources.evidence: The packet's national shares come from this survey. A sample of women and men 15-49, at a coarser geography than admin1; ranked last. Chad is not an Afrobarometer country.

tier_reason: The 2009 census counted religion and ethnic group and INSEED published them by region in PDF volumes on a frame that matches the 23 drawn provinces (with an Ennedi split caveat); nothing I can name is machine-readable without IPUMS registration, and department tables are uncertain.
recommended_action: Crawl inseed.td (and inseed-tchad.org) for the 'RGPH2 2009 Résultats globaux définitifs' and analysis volumes; read religion and ethnicity by region (23 = admin1, checking how Ennedi is handled) and look for department tables (70 drawn; expect a partial join). If the PDFs stop at region, IPUMS-I 2009 microdata gives departments behind registration. Check whether RGPH3 has been enumerated. Leave language null -- do not declare it not_collected without seeing the questionnaire.
not_found: Whether the 2009 questionnaire had a language item
A machine-readable INSEED release of the RGPH2 religion/ethnicity tables
Certainty that department-level tables were published
summary: Chad's 2009 census (RGPH2) asked religion and ethnic group and INSEED published both by region in PDF result volumes; the 22 regions + N'Djamena frame matches the 23 provinces drawn, apart from the 2012 Ennedi split, while the 70 departments drawn join only partly to the census's ~61. IPUMS-I holds the 2009 microdata behind registration and the 2014-15 DHS is the only newer figure and a survey. Tier B: a real count in PDF, nothing machine-readable I can name.
